relevance_note: The paper describes three FLD patients with homozygous LCAT variants: "Genetic analysis revealed new missense homozygous mutations, p.(Ile202Thr) in both siblings and p.(Arg171Glu) in the other patient".
method_note: Read the whole paper; values typed by hand into a small Python builder (scratch dir) and spans checked verbatim by script. Labels: the paper calls the patients 'first/second/third case' (Table 1 headers 'First Case', 'Second Case', 'Third Case'; Tables 2-3 'Second case', 'Third case'), also 'first/second/third patient', 'Patient 3', 'patient 2'; Figure S1 legend gives pedigree positions I.1 (first case) and I.3 (second case). Table 1 has patients as columns (First Case, Second Case, Third Case, Reference Values). Contradictions: (1) Table 1 exogenous LCAT activity is 0.05 / 1.7 / 1.35 nmol/h*mL and endogenous FER 1.50 / 1.40 / 1.90 for cases 1/2/3, whereas the Results text gives 1.70, 0.05 and 1.35 nmol/h*mL and FER 1.40%, 1.5% and 1.9% 'respectively' (first and second cases swapped); both are quoted in functional_evidence_statement. (2) First case: Table 1 'Currently age' 88, but the text says hemodialysis at 75 and death 12 years later; age at death (87 by arithmetic) is not stated directly, so deceased_age_iso8601 is null; age 88 recorded as last evaluation from Table 1. (3) Second case: FPLC text says both siblings had lower LDL-cholesterol than the control, while NMR Table 2 gives her LDL-C 107.44 vs control population 81.5 and Table 1 apoB 131 (reference 73-109); checklist low LDL kept observed from the explicit FPLC statement, flagged. Second case LpX: 'suggesting the presence of some LpX' is hedged, so lipoprotein x left not reported. First case LpX not tested (Figure 5 and NMR used only cases 2 and 3); the Discussion's general attribution of LpX to 'subjects with renal disease' was not used for him. Lab values in Table 1 (e.g. third case apoA-I 30, apoB 35, triglycerides 181; second case triglycerides 158) that the text does not interpret were not turned into features; they appear only as detail on features the text states. Third case biopsy 'thickening of capillary walls' and capillary lipid deposits were not mapped to the glomerular basement membrane checklist item (the paper does not say basement membrane); mesangial deposits/expansion mapped to the mesangial item. 'Renal disease' / 'mild impaired renal function' mapped to the checklist item chronic kidney disease or renal failure. Relatives: genetic analysis 'was extended to all available family members of the siblings (Figure S1)', but no relative is described individually, so no relative rows. Discussion: ref [30] (Rial-Crestelo D et al.) family with one member diagnosed FLD and 'their sister' with FED carrying the same LCAT mutation; included as two literature individuals (sister has a stated sex; the FLD member is an affected relative described in relation to her); no variant printed, so variant rows have variant_original_string 'not reported'. Variants in other people only as groups or without individuals (ref [22] heterozygotes with hypoalphalipoproteinemia; Taramelli ref [6]; p.(Pro34Gln) [25], p.(Pro34Leu) [26]) got no rows. The PLS-DA individual 'later diagnosed with extreme HDL deficiency' has no LCAT link and is out of scope. Transcript NM_012108.3 is printed in Methods for the LCAT sequencing and applied to all three variant rows. is_proband null for all (no proband/index wording). Note for review: the paper prints c.512G>A with p.(Arg171Glu); recorded as printed.
